response.sql: WITH per_coin AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_reb, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_reb) AS b FROM per_coin), sel AS (SELECT p.avg_reb, p.avg_gap, p.avg_reb - bench.b AS excess FROM per_coin p CROSS JOIN bench WHERE p.avg_reb > bench.b) SELECT AVG(avg_reb) AS mean_avg_rebate, AVG(avg_gap) AS mean_avg_relative_gap, AVG(excess) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark FROM sel

assumptions.assumption: The 'maker rebate' is the rebtotal column, and each currency's average is taken over its fee rows. Rows with a NULL feecoin form one group. Currencies whose average rebate is NULL (all rebtotal missing) are skipped in the benchmark average.

The relative gap is averaged per currency first, and those per-currency averages are then averaged equally across the selected currencies. Rows with a zero or NULL feerate or a NULL rebrate give a NULL gap and are skipped.
When no currencies qualify, one row of NULLs is returned.
